diagnostics.message: google_dns_record_set.dns_record_set has an explicit `depends_on = [google_dns_managed_zone.dns_managed_zone]`, but the ordering is already established implicitly: the record set's `name` attribute is `each.value.resource_name`, and `local.recordsets` derives `resource_name` from `local.managed_zone.dns_name`, which resolves to google_dns_managed_zone.dns_managed_zone (or the corresponding data source). That attribute reference already forces the zone to be created before the record set, so the explicit depends_on duplicates it. (The graph misses this because it does not trace through `local` values.)
